items.title_es: Injective CEO Eric Chen expects US INJ ETFs to launch sooner than 2027

items.title: OKX, NYSE parent ICE joint venture seeks to launch tokenized US stock trading venue
items.summary: OKXICE has notified the SEC that it intends to launch a tokenized securities trading venue under the innovation exemption.
items.title_es: OKX, NYSE parent ICE joint venture seeks to launch tokenized US stock trading venue

items.title: Trump Taps Jay Clayton, the SEC Chair Who Sued Ripple, to Lead AI Push
items.summary: President Trump named a new "Super Intelligence Force" to coordinate federal AI policy, with Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton at the helm. As SEC chair, Clayton launched crypto lawsuits including the agency's case against Ripple.
items.title_es: Trump Taps Jay Clayton, the SEC Chair Who Sued Ripple, to Lead AI Push

items.title: Banking Group Sues to Block Crypto's 'Side Door' Into the Banking System
items.summary: The Independent Community Bankers of America argues the OCC's national trust charters give crypto firms a "side door into the banking system" without the safeguards that bind traditional banks.
items.title_es: Banking Group Sues to Block Crypto's 'Side Door' Into the Banking System

items.title: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $134.4 million over the first two trading days of October, rebounding from a Sept. 30 outflow as a weak jobs report cooled Fed rate-hike bets.
items.title_es: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
